question_text: Explain how you diagnose a cable run that fails under heavy data load.
expected_answer: You test for crosstalk signal loss and improper termination using certification tools

question_text: Describe how you identify hidden damage in long cable runs.
expected_answer: You use TDR tools inspect conduit and locate faults along the cable path

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot severe interference affecting a cable run.
expected_answer: You analyze routing shielding and nearby electrical sources and reroute if needed

question_text: Describe how you verify whether a cable bundle is causing performance degradation.
expected_answer: You check bend radius tension and separation from power lines and test throughput

question_text: Explain how you diagnose PoE failure on long cable runs.
expected_answer: You measure voltage drop check cable quality and inspect termination integrity

question_text: Describe how you identify a failing connector that passes basic continuity tests.
expected_answer: You test for intermittent contact inspect pin alignment and replace the connector

question_text: Explain how you troubleshoot a cable run that intermittently drops gigabit speeds.
expected_answer: You check for microbends poor termination and cable category mismatch

question_text: Describe the process for validating cable performance in high bandwidth environments.
expected_answer: You use certification tools test throughput and verify signal integrity

question_text: Explain how you diagnose a cable issue inside conduit.
expected_answer: You use pull tests inspection cameras and TDR readings to locate faults

question_text: Describe how you evaluate whether a cable installation meets enterprise standards.
expected_answer: You check certification routing support and termination quality thoroughly
